BiblicalUsage: The locust has laid the vine waste and barked the fig tree, made it clean bare, and cast it away — the branches made white. The word is the fragment chipped off, the bark stripped clean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the locusts that bark the fig tree are God's messengers too, and Joel names the stripped branches so we will see it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
